title: piper arboreum var. stamineum
intro: Piper arboreum var. stamineum, commonly known as the "Kava of the Gods," is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands, belonging to the Piperaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The health benefits of Piper arboreum var. stamineum are attributed to its therapeutic actions as an anxiolytic, sedative, and muscle relaxant, which can also help to alleviate pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include kavalactones, such as kavain, desmethoxyyangonin, and dihydrokavain, which have been shown to interact with the body's GABA receptors to produce a calming effect.
